title: Is UK CBAM due on this consignment into Northern Ireland?
sub: For iron and steel, aluminium, cement, fertiliser and hydrogen arriving from 1 January 2027. Status 21 November 2026.
note: Electricity is not in UK CBAM. Who counts as the importer for goods arriving from Ireland with no customs declaration is not settled in HMRC guidance: ask HMRC in writing. General information, not legal, tax or customs advice.
nodes: A covered good arrives in NI from outside the UK
start
Is it UK origin (last substantial processing in the UK)?
q
Out of scope. Keep the origin evidence.
out
Is it EU, EEA or Swiss origin, and is the UK exemption law on the import date?
q
No UK CBAM once the exemption is law. Keep the evidence.
out
Are the importer's CBAM goods £50,000 or more (next 30 days or last 12 months)?
q
Below threshold. Keep checking both tests.
warn
Was it released into the EU first, with EU CBAM paid?
q
Likely double charge: no EU refund, relief doubtful. Re-route.
pay
Can the producer give verified installation emissions and the carbon price paid?
q
UK CBAM due, less carbon price relief.
warn
UK CBAM due on default values. Look for a UK or NI source.
pay
